# third_party

## open-humanizer
Vendored, **unmodified** copy of https://github.com/pandeyvishwas51-oss/open-humanizer (commit `5307df8`, v1.0.0, MIT, see `open-humanizer/LICENSE`).
Every file of the upstream repository is here exactly as published (nothing removed, nothing edited). It is used only through `src/humanize.py`, which
imports the package from this folder at run time. To update: replace the folder with a fresh copy and run `python tests/humanize_test.py`.
